title: The staying power of leveraged buyouts

rival_explanations: divisional buyouts return to public ownership because divisional managers buy a division the parent was mismanaging, fix it, and exit (Kaplan and Weisbach divestiture view), which predicts the opposite sign for the same divisional-versus-public comparison
